primary.title: Gifting money to an NRI child: how is TCS calculated under LRS, and can you claim a refund?
primary.summary: A ₹25 lakh gift to an NRI daughter is tax-free in her hands, but the remittance may attract TCS under LRS. Here's how the rules differ for overseas and NRO transfers.
